modelingNotes: OSM supplies the rotated 242 x 87 m outline and two long raised roof polygons: way/251637908 has 15 m eaves/17 m ridge; way/251637906 has 17 m eaves/19 m ridge. Both authored LODs preserve these plans and heights.

The selected Commons photograph P1080895 Paris XIX grande halle de la Villette (7def463a) establishes three stepped roof levels, slender cast-iron columns and ties, gable lattice and an open entrance canopy. The former solid ground envelope becomes a slab, structural piers and opaque structural glazing.

The 10 m lower eave and 16 m main ridge retain the previous interpretation. The mapped front raised area defines the open canopy extent; missing level dimensions, framing spacing, glazed bay subdivision and roof seams are proportional interpretations from the photograph, not survey measurements.
Temporary event banners, equipment and photographic textures are omitted. Structural glazing uses glass. Low LOD retains open canopy, roof hierarchy and principal frame, with half the bay density.
